posts.title: The Monster Is Loose … Cracking Monsters Is Here!
posts.description: My new book, Cracking Monsters, is officially here! It’s my fourth Middle Grade/Young Adult novel, my fourteenth book overall, and the second adventure in The Uncrackables series.

posts.title: Cracking Time: A New Mystery Begins in Infinity Point
posts.description: A new mystery begins in Infinity Point. Cracking Time launches The Uncrackables series with puzzles, secrets, and an adventure that starts when the internet goes dark.

posts.title: It’s time for … Cracking Time!
posts.description: My new book, Cracking Time, is finally here! This is my third Middle Grade / Young Adult book and my thirteenth book overall. It’s about a kid named Andy Wagner who's sent to an ultra-strange digital addiction camp. Determined to get his device back, he sneaks out only to discover the camp isn't helping kids … it's using them!
